case: BASS-II B6 / sample 153m / 0.1 mm PMMA / 20 mm

comparators.source: Carmignani (2019) dissertation, Ch. 5 (B6 at nominal 3 cm/s)

comparators.status: source_reported; NOT linked to B6 (no run-level join) — context only

assessment: Consistent in magnitude with both published statements. FiF is ~0.27 mm/s (~14%) above Carmignani's approximate value; the difference cannot be judged significant because the comparator's exact interval, threshold and uncertainty are not published, and the pending scale-plane correction (ISS-020) can only lower the FiF value if the ruler lies behind the sample plane.
physics_observation: Windowed rates stay within ~2.1–2.4 mm/s while the displayed AIR value rises 3 → 4 → 5; spread rate nearly independent of opposing flow, consistent with the thin-fuel thermal regime reported by NASA. Observation, not proof.
anomaly_noted: 8-s window 22–30 s gives 2.61 mm/s; coincides with a bracketed frame of different exposure (t=26.57 s, 1/60 s). Candidate processing artefact; flagged for the anomaly-detection prototype.
